name: Microgrid reconnect preparation block
summary: Checks the defined prerequisites before attempting the selected return to grid connection.
description: Checks the defined prerequisites before attempting the selected return to grid connection. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Utility availability and island state” at the input and “Reconnection preparation state” at the output. Reconnection needs the assigned synchronising conditions.
